goal: Tenant administrators can safely operate logistics configuration, mappings, failures, maintenance, and metrics.
non_goals: Do not configure production credentials, deploy, or auto-subscribe history.
Do not delete Delivery, shipment, order, or active audit history.
expected_evidence: Secret masking and safe error tests
Dry-run backfill, bounded cleanup, retry, and metrics tests
Frontend operations state tests and production build
unsafe_assumptions: Do not assume verification enables Provider features.
Do not assume historical shipments have complete relationships.
stop_condition: Stop if an operation exposes secrets, performs unbounded maintenance, or mutates business history.
